question: What library-specific macrophage-like Arg1 and fibroblast-like Il6 descriptions accompany P2rx4-KO versus WT fibroblast coculture, and fibroblast Il6 in WT coculture versus fibroblast alone?
decision: Assess descriptive consistency and heterogeneity for the three source-linked RNA endpoints before further review; no population effect or scientific acceptance.
strongest_rival: Unknown preparation/batch and class selection, ambient RNA and mixed cells may explain library differences without an identifiable genotype or within-state biological effect.
discriminator: Separate per-library/class transcript summaries from composition, retain both fixed QC masks and every crossed library difference; this cannot remove preparation or selection confounding.
exposure_record: Published findings, functional reconstructions, technical QC and conservative annotation are exposed. Local class-specific Arg1/Il6 endpoints have not been calculated; neither gene was used for annotation or coverage qualification.
biological_unit: Coculture preparation/animal pooling and biological independence are unknown; report libraries, with cells nested within libraries.
nesting_and_overlap: Slices and wells nest in source patients or donor combinations; cells nest in libraries. Numeric library suffixes do not prove preparation pairing. Source panels and deposited data are reused published evidence, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: All six public GSE242510 libraries, their frozen conservative core classes and both fixed QC masks; mixed, other and unassigned cells remain in saved data.
contrast: Three fixed endpoint contrasts: macrophage-like Arg1 KO versus WT coculture; fibroblast-like Il6 KO versus WT coculture and WT coculture versus Fib alone. Equal-weight library means, no suffix pairing.
endpoint: Primary class/library mean log1p counts per 10000; companion detection fraction, arithmetic mean per 10000 and pseudobulk CPM. Arg1/Il6 raw counts retained for all barcodes.
methods: Exact rna_endpoints_spec_v1.json; frozen annotation/class eligibility; two QC masks; all four crossed library differences per contrast. Independent stream reader checks all target vectors and library summary arithmetic.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep all barcode target counts and frozen labels/QC flags. Only eligible core library/classes enter summaries; no retuning. Require both libraries per condition; failed joins or verification stop execution.
multiplicity: Three prespecified descriptive comparisons, four metrics, two QC masks. No p-values, population tests, confidence intervals or endpoint selection.
precision_basis: Technical source checks do not estimate population precision.
interpretation_limit: Library descriptions on adapted marker classes, not pure lineages, biological replicates, secretion, arginase activity, flux, causal genotype effects or mediation.
stop_rule: Stop after the three frozen RNA comparisons and independent numerical checks. No cell-based DE, inferred pairing, new genes, Compass, CellChat, spatial reconstruction or thesis promotion.
amendment_reason: Initial frozen R1 endpoints after functional reconstruction, full-entry integrity and conservative annotation.
